description: Comprehensive bibliography and structured outputs from the Active Inference Meta-Analysis project — a computational meta-analysis of 817 papers across the Active Inference and Free Energy Principle literature. Includes curated references, hypothesis evidence scores, citation network analysis, topic modeling, subfield classification, and corpus assessment statistics.
